CURRENT HANDOFF STATE / 2026-11-12 / REV15P + REV15P2 NIGHT ATMOSPHERE
Status and authorization
The isolated native night pilot and the optimized browser lighting pass are complete. The user approved the retained look (“I like it lets move ahead”), requested preservation of the original quarry movement, and then explicitly requested this document update and upload of missing output files. This dated handoff supersedes the stale READY TO RUN status above. The original no-Drive-writes restriction is retained as historical prompt text; the user's latest explicit instruction now authorizes these documentation and output-backup writes. It does not authorize deployment.
Completed native result — Rev15P
Native output: reports/night-atmosphere-rev15p-pilot-2026-11-11/delivery/Gullyverse-Rev15P-Night-Atmosphere-Pilot.blend. Size 171,729,972 bytes; SHA-256 f539f05e9fe2e82d2909a79f326f6b53485d3e00832707a51ab073c269d95682. Blender 4.3.2. The active scene is REV15P / Isolated Night Atmosphere Pilot. All 45 original scenes are retained, for 46 total; 69 images are packed. All eight mural states were independently checked after reopening. The original Rev15O master remains unchanged (SHA-256 2c78b57e97a5a97683f946d60ad265b22a1eb88ae12abed6220ec268ce473657).
The look uses a lower cool ambient fill, three warm shop-light pools, damp ground roughness and moderate distance fog. Earlier environment geometry and artwork are preserved: eight Team murals with Organising Committee first and no Coordinator panel; full-form heading, black painted brick, foreground team titles with portraits behind, and name/role placement; upward Aftermovie sign, bottom Past Sponsors plaque and closely hung LED with wider gaps; the retained Aftermovie-style native crowd; the existing warm Events/cypher house façade; and removal of 204 low ground-house rail pieces while retaining upper balconies. The native source retains 189 crowd models. Browser subset counts must not be confused with native counts.
Completed browser result — Rev15P2
Private viewer: reports/night-atmosphere-rev15p2-browser-2026-11-12/viewer/. The optimized pilot.glb is 16,701,980 bytes; SHA-256 19c87693399d6cb004ba696e48b6ae357548e421e5bd54b09f69984f5d5e4588. It preserves the baseline's 447,269 triangles, transforms, indices, UV0 and source artwork image bytes. Static native lighting is baked into vertex colour with material extra nativeLightfieldScale=32; the supplied viewer applies that scale. Four ground materials use a corrected bounded UV1 atlas, native roughness and a specular-only runtime light. The LED keeps 62 logos, 72-cell gaps, a 10,676-cell loop at 30 cells/second, fog handling and reduced-motion pause.
The browser export remains a representative subset with the current Organising Committee artwork. It is not a delivery of the complete native crowd, the full native stage or an eight-slide browser carousel. The native packed scene preserves those source states. Do not replace the production model with this GLB alone or load it in an arbitrary viewer without its documented material binding.
Measured checks and limits
The matching baseline/update harness used two warm-up frames and five measured frames per camera, including a synchronous one-pixel readback to force GPU completion. On cloud Chromium/SwiftShader, serialized render cost fell by approximately 61–71% for desktop framing and 47–56% for emulated mobile. Far/middle/near image differences against the native reference also fell. These are comparative measurements, not certified hardware FPS. Texture residency estimates rose slightly with the corrected ground atlas; draw calls were not reduced. Requested desktop 60 FPS and mobile 30 FPS goals remain unmet on this software renderer. Physical phone/GPU performance, thermals, battery use and full-world input latency remain unmeasured; no completed KTX2 compression pipeline is claimed.
One canvas, HTML directions fallback, reduced-motion LED handling, source geometry/artwork checks and ground-atlas checks passed in the recorded pilot tests. No console or page errors were recorded in the final comparison run. Exact raw measurements and limitations are retained in REPORT.md and evidence/browser-comparison.json inside the browser checkpoint.
Quarry movement and website status
All eight previously recorded movement/rendering files were rehashed during this handoff and still match: runtime.ts, navigation.ts, input.ts, rendering.tsx, ImmersiveShell.tsx, HubScene.tsx, CaveEntrance.tsx and world.ts. The original quarry entrance, walking controls and transitions have not been rewritten. This preservation check does not mean that the new night model is already walkable with those controls. Production route integration has not been performed. The work-in-progress-2027 branch remains at 0e1e23dd2f5181df202d862d147067249bc55a41; the existing README edit predates this phase. No commit, push, merge, PR or deployment was made.
PDF reviews already on Drive
Latest browser comparison and night review: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Sa9tBen_AD-pgb1fgLBMvD1CX4hR7N7-/view?usp=drivesdk — five pages, 16,814,058 bytes; SHA-256 a14fd4a35e8052e14acd6933b729f58ebc531510cc1f21fdfd0d9ed1c7cfbbdd.
Native pilot review: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZLlaD9XLDTBdhiiXC3AjWg4GvDzZi3cK/view?usp=drivesdk — five pages, 19,758,437 bytes; SHA-256 18b2c7adb88ae921d07567521b21f601105e7901b213e303a6797b9fd7370ff9. Both review files were already verified by parent, size and download-back SHA-256; they are reused, not duplicated. Continue to deliver visual previews in PDF as requested by the user.
Verified source backup and restoration
Packed native/base checkpoint folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/19lLbeomN6cqhASBobc3T2SvmUHoz8wKG
Rev15P2 browser checkpoint folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Ou_LWPXLKovvTrDRnSdpsBpWvupbhyzq
Recovery index, restoration script and native document snapshots: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vIEijMklnKneib70t0xEnHo9mKaZQ7dh
The unchanged complete base ZIP is 251,926,300 bytes, SHA-256 df53edfb1d95dde30c3e3dfe140a730daec7a8b50d4dd79e575df7f8ba5340ac, stored as 11 ordered parts. The unchanged incremental browser ZIP is 41,682,228 bytes, SHA-256 d9eea72be896256505ece49079ae4ca21eb506ce7b98be6c277dce5815c04fea, stored as two ordered parts. Total original archive bytes: 293,608,528. Each uploaded part was downloaded through authenticated Drive access and checked against the original slice's byte size and SHA-256; remote parent folders were checked too. All 92 base and 64 incremental archive payloads were rechecked locally by byte size, CRC and SHA-256. Earlier fresh-open verification of the restored packed native scene remains included.
Download all 13 .partNNN files, SOURCE-CHECKPOINT-INDEX.json and restore-checkpoints.py. Run the restoration script into a new empty directory. It verifies parts and complete ZIPs, extracts the base first and then the incremental archive, and verifies every extracted payload. The complete packed Blender source, exact baseline GLB, updated browser GLB, bundled Three.js runtime, textures, bake/build/test scripts, reports, screenshots and PDFs are retained. The older LOCAL ONLY wording inside the immutable historical ZIPs describes their original delivery date; this handoff and its verified Drive receipts record the later authorized upload. Earlier backups and sharing settings are preserved.
Next implementation step — authorized, not yet delivered
Build a private walkable preview using the approved night assets and the existing movement/input/frame controller. Preserve the original bent quarry entrance path, its timing, walking feel and covered entrance/exit transitions. Fit the new private hub bounds, floor-height handling and destination placement to the native lane without changing the production registry. Verify entrance-to-lane continuity, walls/collisions, floor height, keyboard/pointer/touch input, Aftermovie departure and return, and fallback/reduced-motion behaviour. Capture review views into a PDF. No Rev15P3 walkable bundle, route or completed walkthrough test currently exists; the preceding investigation was read-only. Do not report this planned step as completed.
Open decisions
The rejected Schedule navigation label still needs a useful replacement. Festival Guide is a suggestion only and is not approved. Hardware validation, texture compression/streaming and full-scene optimization remain future work. These open points do not block restoring or reviewing the approved private night pilot.
END CURRENT HANDOFF / 2026-11-12
